column1: # capture<TAB>title<TAB>glyph (U+XXXX, or nothing); a title of * is every title of the capture.
# GitHub Copilot sets its title as OSC 0 (byte 280 of each capture) after its start-up queries and before it has
# drawn anything (its first drawing starts at byte 337, with the tab bar of its welcome screen), in the captures taken
# from its start: the trust screens, the empty composer's, the opened sidebar's, the forms', and the first of the
# commands', feedback prompt's, images', permission prompts' (of every kind), questions' (the wrapped one too) and
# stash's. The other captures hold only titles set after drawing, or none.
